title: New York auto-repair licensee evidence and public-business-contact hold
hypothesis: The implemented NY DMV RS/RSB adapter can retain a current named licensee candidate for a repair facility, but its facility address and person-form owner_name do not establish current business ownership, a direct business line, or handset ownership. With no register phone, the safe route holds for an explicitly published business contact and independent owner/direct-contact evidence; it never discovers a residence or private phone.
ownerSource: The implemented ny_repair_shops adapter accepts current RS and RSB rows and person-form owner_name values, then labels the result Owner. This is licensee-of-record candidate evidence only; it is not owner confirmation or handset evidence.
phoneSource: NY DMV repair-shop rows have no parsed phone. The only proposed alternative is an explicitly published business contact for the same facility. A missing, shared, or unlinked contact holds; parcel lookup, skip tracing, private-phone append, and residential/property matching are outside this workflow.

workflow.label: Current NY DMV RS/RSB row
workflow.detail: Read only the implemented ny_repair_shops parser output: future-expiring RS or RSB record, person-form licensee candidate, and facility facts. The source has no parsed phone.

workflow.label: In-scope current license?
workflow.detail: Keep RS and RSB only when the expiry is in the future and owner_name parses as a person; preserve RSB as body-repair scope rather than silently widening it.

workflow.label: Hold invalid license row
workflow.detail: Expired, non-RS/RSB, entity-name, or incomplete-person rows do not become repair or owner candidates.

workflow.label: Named licensee candidate
workflow.detail: The adapter's historical Owner label means the person was named in owner_name. It does not prove current ownership, a direct business contact, or a handset.

workflow.label: Explicit public business contact?
workflow.detail: A future lawful route may consider only a number explicitly published for the same facility. The DMV record itself supplies none.

workflow.label: Hold for public business contact
workflow.detail: Set phoneless NY repair-register rows to held/public_business_contact_required. Do not parcel-match or trace the named person or facility.

workflow.label: Current owner and direct-contact evidence?
workflow.detail: Require independent current owner/founder evidence and an explicit link from that person to the published business contact. A shared reception or directory number does not pass.

workflow.label: Hold shared or unlinked contact
workflow.detail: Keep a public business contact unlabelled when current ownership or a direct-business-contact link is unresolved.

workflow.label: Authorized contact gates
workflow.detail: Only after public contact and owner/direct-contact support, evaluate separately authorized line type, reachability, DNC/TCPA, suppression, duplicate, freshness, and timezone controls.

workflow.label: Hold failed contact gate
workflow.detail: A failed or unavailable contact/compliance check cannot be treated as owner confirmation.

workflow.label: Deliver supported contact
workflow.detail: Deliver only when the public-business-contact, independent owner/direct-contact, and authorized contact gates all pass.

edges.label: expired, out of scope, or not a person
no register phone or private lookup proposed
a gate fails or is unavailable

failures.risk: The adapter's titleCode Owner and the DMV owner_name field are represented as current ownership or owner-handset proof.
failures.mitigation: Describe the value as named licensee-of-record candidate evidence and require independent current owner/direct-business-contact evidence before an owner-labelled delivery.

failures.risk: The live recipe-B path sends phoneless ny_repair_shops rows to owner-occupied parcel lookup and then paid BatchData skip tracing.
failures.mitigation: Before parcelStep and traceStep, hold auto_repair_ny / ny_repair_shops phoneless rows as public_business_contact_required and exclude them from both private-route selectors.

failures.risk: An expired RS/RSB, non-repair ISP, entity owner_name, or incomplete name reaches a named-person path.
failures.mitigation: Retain nyRepairShopRow's RS/RSB, future-expiry, and traceable-person checks and preserve their skip reasons.

failures.risk: A public directory, reception, or shared shop line is treated as a direct line for the named licensee.
failures.mitigation: Hold the contact unless it is explicitly published for the same facility and independently linked to its current owner; then run authorized contact gates.

iterations.hypothesis: The saved NY repair fixture demonstrates that the adapter retains only current in-scope person-form repair rows and does not create a phone candidate.
iterations.test: Five-case local fixture/code audit on 2026-09-24: parse tests/fixtures/registers/ny_repair_shops.json through nyRepairShops with node --experimental-strip-types. No network, DMV request, provider, secret, paid call, residential lookup, or contact-data export.
iterations.observed: Of five saved rows, three were retained: two RS Repair Shop and one RSB Repair Shop (body). One expired RS was held as expired and one ISP was held as business_type_out_of_scope. No retained row had a parsed phone. This is parser behavior only, not live coverage, ownership, public-contact, handset, compliance, or delivery evidence.
iterations.change: Keep the adapter as license and named-licensee-candidate evidence. Do not call its Owner label or facility address owner/mobile proof, and do not infer a public contact from this fixture.

iterations.hypothesis: The live NY recipe has a safe public-business-contact path before private enrichment.
iterations.test: Local code audit on 2026-09-24 of the auto_repair_ny recipe-B mapping, pullNames, homeStreetSource, parcelStep, and traceStep. No job, provider, parcel, or trace call was run.
iterations.observed: auto_repair_ny maps to ny_repair_shops with recipe B. ny_repair_shops is not a register-home-street source, so phoneless parsed people remain eligible for owner-occupied parcel lookup; a parcel match makes them eligible for BatchData skip tracing. No public-business-contact or owner-evidence hold intervenes.
iterations.change: Propose a source-specific pre-parcel/pre-trace hold for ny_repair_shops and a later facility-matched published-business-contact route. This removes the private route without adding any enrichment.

measurement.result: Five saved NY repair-register rows parsed locally: three current in-scope person-form RS/RSB rows retained, one expired RS held, one ISP held, and zero parsed phone candidates. This is a local fixture/code audit only; no DMV endpoint, owner/contact, handset, line, reachability, DNC/TCPA, or delivery outcome was measured.

cost.basis: Local fixture and code audit only; no provider, parcel, trace, DMV request, or private-phone enrichment was invoked.
cost.note: No clean owner or business contact was measured. The live brain's research estimates have a different denominator and do not establish cost per supported contact.

implementation.summary: The NY adapter implements current RS/RSB and person-form parsing, storing facility facts and no phone. The live brain maps it to recipe B, whose generic path stores the person in owner_name and allows phoneless rows into residential parcel lookup and paid skip tracing. No public-business-contact hold or independent owner/direct-contact gate is wired for auto_repair_ny.

nextMeasurement: After the source-specific hold is implemented, run a synthetic job-row regression proving ny_repair_shops phoneless rows become held with public_business_contact_required and cannot reach parcel or trace. A later authorized aggregate study may measure explicit facility-matched public business contacts, shared contacts, independently supported current owners, and authorized contact outcomes; it must not use residential/property data or private-phone append.
